items.job: Replace dual clutch assembly and input shaft seals
items.note: Ford's past clutch warranty extensions have mostly ended, but ask a dealer to check your VIN. Clutches may wear out again.

items.job: Replace and program transmission control module
items.note: Ford extended TCM coverage to 10 years/150,000 miles on many cars. Check your VIN with a dealer; coverage may have run out.

items.t: Stalling after refueling or crushed fuel tank
items.job: Replace canister purge valve and update engine software
items.note: Covered by a Ford recall; check your VIN. If the fuel tank is crushed, tank replacement adds a lot.

items.t: Door won't latch or bounces open
items.note: Price is per door. Covered by Ford door latch recalls; check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.
